messages.author: 82e8106f84fe4fab
messages.subject: stan model works on Mac but not on Windows
parts:
Dear all,

I ran my stan model (attached) on my Mac computer and it runs without any errors. However when I ran the exact same model on my windows, it throws the following exception. It says the variable "tc" does not exist but I checked and the variable tc is being based to stan and it is not empty. Would really appreciate it if anyone could help point me in the direction as to what could be wrong as it seems weird that it works on one platform but not the other. Thank you in advance.
